svg.title: Orbit Remote attacker positions and defences
svg.desc: A matrix of seven attacker positions against eleven defences. A tailnet peer without an invite is stopped by mutual TLS with the certificate pin and by the invite, and limited by pre-authentication limits. A paired peer with limited grants is stopped by per-request grants. A malicious paired host is stopped by the invite (it cannot view you back), the Electron sandbox and IPC, and peer-data checks. Another local user is stopped by mutual TLS, the invite, the local control channel token and key storage. Malware running as the user is outside the boundary; the launch policy only limits it. A website is stopped by mutual TLS, the local control channel's browser refusal and the Electron app, which registers no protocol handler. A compromised dependency runs with the app's rights; the Electron sandbox and supply-chain controls only limit it. Pre-auth limits bound denial of service only.
